decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the required historical ticket backfill and applicable visibility contexts, so no additional propagation is needed.
A complete same-message MODIFY already requires historical commission and ticket backfill in NFT attributes, and the existing metadata scope includes dynamic metadata.
Commission and ticket accounting visibility does not change NFT image sizing or media rendering behavior.
The source concerns reward totals and backfill, not whether successfully minted NFTs appear in the user's dashboard inventory.
The source distinguishes commission and ticket accounting from referral-code usage but does not change displayed referral-count behavior.
The leaderboard evidence concerns ticket and commission totals, not public referral-count statistics.
Using twelve completed mints as the reconciliation basis does not modify the separate rule governing public mint-count accuracy.
Reward-accounting backfill does not change the label or measure of the public next-draw countdown.
The source reports missing ticket and commission records but makes no decision about displayed prize-pool totals.
The FAQ already explains random allocation for no-referral mints, while the source's historical backfill requirement concerns operational accounting data rather than FAQ copy.
The accounting and backfill decision does not alter the deferred wallet-provisioning mechanism for fiat buyers.
The source does not change certificate-email availability, contents, or actions.
